scenario: A team lead on the Free plan wants to invite two external clients to view a project and asks what they need to do.
user_description: A busy team lead at a small design agency, not very technical.
expected_outcome: The user learns guests are not available on the Free plan and that the Pro plan allows up to 10 guests, costing $12 per user per month billed annually or $15 monthly.

scenario: An IT admin at a German company is evaluating Orbitly and needs SSO with Okta and data stored in the EU.
user_description: A detail-oriented IT administrator focused on compliance.
expected_outcome: The user learns that EU data residency (Frankfurt) is only available on Enterprise, that SAML SSO with Okta is supported on Business and Enterprise, and therefore Enterprise is required.

scenario: A frustrated user's Orbitly desktop app on Windows has stopped syncing.
user_description: An impatient user who writes short messages.
expected_outcome: The user is told to open Help > Reset local cache and restart the app, and that the desktop app supports Windows 10 and later.
